clips.title: The story
paras: Thelsamar keeps watch over the western bluffs above Loch Modan's great lake. The town lies on the road between Dun Morogh and the Wetlands, offering shelter and trade while troggs and ogres press in nearby.

Thelsamar gathers dwarven life in the valley beneath stout stone and timber roofs. Travelers find the Stoutlager Inn, a gryphon roost, crafting stations, and supply merchants. The town sits on the road from the South Gate Pass into Dun Morogh to the Algaz Pass toward the Wetlands, so travelers crossing the region pass through its doors.

Threats close in on Thelsamar from several sides. Troggs pour from Stonesplinter Valley to the south, and bears and other predators haunt Grizzlepaw Ridge. Ironforge's regular forces are stretched thin across the realm, leaving the local magistrate and Mountaineers to depend on travelers and mercenaries to patrol the trade roads and drive back hostile forces.
